top_signals.title: Metals Rout Deepens as AI, Fed Worries Fuel Bearish Sentiment
top_signals.summary: Copper, aluminum and tin all added to Tuesday’s fierce selloff in metals as tech stocks extended losses and traders braced for US inflation data that will feed the Federal Reserve’s next moves on interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
